psxbios.bin in this folder is OpenBIOS, a free replacement for the PlayStation BIOS,
written by the PCSX-Redux authors and released under the MIT licence (OpenBIOS-LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://github.com/grumpycoders/pcsx-redux (src/mips/openbios)
Binary: Libreboot 20241206 build, roms/playstation/openbios.bin
SHA-512: b953da6507ba049eb7323f85d0fcba58e3e2ad21233468b3c417948d20bc2a024a9e27bdc3609e882b768aebd147a814ab8b51bc3be93a779e1e6a18e57df29b

Not all games boot with it, it has no memory card save handler and it does not play music CDs.
For full compatibility replace psxbios.bin with a dump of your own console's BIOS (512 KB).
